question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters K, N, A, B, C and Z. Two positions of the same dice are given below. Which face is opposite to face A?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f42fecd90907e80dbdf7014bc59f7f4965bd833705aeb31db6dac55fd4ca0a79.png]
solution:
The logic follows here,

In these types of dice problems, we should write all three numbers/letters in clockwise or anticlockwise from a fix common number/letter

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn010.adda247.com/a6787243-4505-4bb6-81e3-3bf0d918f5ce.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn010.adda247.com/ec4c4b82-7d3f-4ba5-a42a-6d724c6c4962.png] 

So, Z ​is opposite to face A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
